title: Super Bowl VII
overview: Super Bowl VII, played on January 14, 1973, at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum, was a historic game that cemented the Miami Dolphins’ place in NFL history. With their 14-7 victory over the Washington Redskins, the Dolphins completed the first—and still only—perfect season in NFL history, finishing 17-0. The win capped off a remarkable year for Miami, which had dominated the league with a suffocating defense, a powerful running game, and efficient quarterback play.
